# `lakana recovery`

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from the Typer app. Do not edit by hand:
run `uv run python scripts/generate_reference.py` and commit the result. -->

Part of the [Command line reference](../cli.md), which lists the options for every command.

Usage: `lakana recovery [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

Recovery links for people who lost their passkeys (ADMIN).

## `lakana recovery create`

Usage: `lakana recovery create [OPTIONS] {name}`

Issue a recovery link for NAME, who lost their passkeys; prints the link to send them.

The link works once, for 1 hour, and stops working if you are deactivated or lose the ADMIN role first. Using it removes NAME's passkeys, ends their sessions and tells them and every administrator. Recovering an administrator, meaning anyone who holds or has ever held the ADMIN role, directly or through a group, is for the server operator only: run this where the server runs, with the profile that holds the bootstrap token (the one 'lakana bundle init' or 'lakana server start --local' saved). Only the link goes to stdout.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | text | required |  |

## `lakana recovery list`

Usage: `lakana recovery list [OPTIONS]`

List the open recovery links (never the links themselves).

## `lakana recovery withdraw`

Usage: `lakana recovery withdraw [OPTIONS] {ID}`

Withdraw the open recovery link ID; it stops working at once.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | text | required |  |
